summary: Repair RTT listener contract and lifetime on its existing IMS route; review all 22 assigned requirements without closing package/runtime gaps.

requirements_review.finding: No fusion-fence implementation/export was found. Existing GNSS and beacon fences are separate paths and do not implement the SDK fusion type/scene request contract.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Implement real fused GNSS/cellular/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth fence backend, capability query and IPC/bindings; validate supported and unsupported combinations, add/remove ownership, transitions and permissions.

requirements_review.finding: No current-district API implementation was found in fixed production source. Existing point geocoding/location APIs do not supply the new request/cache/current-fix district orchestration. The recorded image also lacks location/geocoder provider operation.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Implement permission-checked current-fix and reverse-geocoder district orchestration, cache policy and service errors; supply actual location/geocoder providers and validate real district/error boundaries.

requirements_review.finding: Dynamic NAPI export is absent. Static Taihe implementation explicitly throws ERRCODE_NOT_SUPPORTED; its return 0 is unreachable fallback. RDB working-state helper exists, but production source only resets it to 0 and exposes no active/HD icon state producer.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Implement an authoritative per-user active/HD location icon state producer and permission-checked query, then wire both language surfaces; test active, idle, HD and user/permission boundaries.

requirements_review.finding: No post-processing track implementation/export was found. SDK requires SKIING post-processing, records up to 24 hours and incremental reads; raw cached GNSS fixes or an empty array cannot satisfy that contract.
evidence: backend-excerpts.json: icon producer audit where applicable
requirements_review.next_required: Provide genuine sports trajectory post-processing, per-caller history/cursor and retention semantics, plus GNSS input provider and permission-checked NAPI; validate real tracks, retention and repeated-read boundaries.

requirements_review.finding: No on/offCommunicationStateChange implementation or export appears in the 43 production state_registry files scanned. SDK describes a boolean 5A state, so mapping generic call state or network-present to this event would change the contract.

requirements_review.finding: Prior complete packaged evidence reports no GNSS/location provider, zero enabled callbacks and 3301100 while disabled. Fixed source has real locator/GNSS service classes, which alone cannot create a QEMU sensor/provider transport.
requirements_review.next_required: Add a real GNSS/location provider and QEMU device/transport route; package and validate current-location callbacks, trajectory, fences and disabled/permission cases.

requirements_review.finding: Prior complete packaged evidence reports no modem/SIM/radio transport. Enabling RTT compile gates exposes the framework path, without supplying a radio/IMS network.
requirements_review.next_required: Provide actual modem/SIM/radio plus IMS transport for QEMU; validate calls, SMS, data and RTT sessions with positive service outcomes and device-absent errors.
